assessment: The proposed candidate-bearing versus candidate-free contrast does not identify lexical causality. It can show downstream dependence conditional on a preceding event, but that dependence is compatible with a plain sequential-link model. This is a design critique only; it adds no manuscript finding.
countermodel: Let each record template deterministically order action A before state field S, with S selected by the action, a latent material/batch, or a template class. Insert the recurring candidate C only in templates whose next field is S. C has no causal connective meaning; it is a sequence/template marker or redundant header. Then C precedes S, S is statistically dependent on A, C-bearing records have more downstream states, and a position-controlled candidate/no-candidate comparison can reproduce the proposed causal signal. The causal and sequential models therefore have identical observables under the current design.
relation_to_f29: The earlier f29 review already separates written wet/dry order from a temporal operation: order is conditional on a fixed carrier, and parallel part-state readings remain possible. IDEA000030 must not treat adjacency plus a dependent state as a new causal or temporal finding.
minimal_discriminant: Predeclare a contrast in which the same preceding event, record position, carrier/template class, and downstream field are held fixed while C varies, with the downstream state independently determined before C is interpreted. The causal model must predict a C-specific change in the downstream state or an independently bounded outcome; the sequential model predicts no change after those controls. If exact matched pairs are unavailable, the design is not identified.
independent_endpoints: A source-bound, independently coded downstream state/outcome whose coding does not use C, its gloss, or the candidate's position.
Held records or externally anchored repeated cases with a predeclared consequence distinction; same-record repetition and fluent reconstruction are insufficient.
falsifier_scope: A null held conditional-consequence contrast would falsify the proposed causal mechanism only after the independent endpoint and matched sequential controls pass. A positional association alone falsifies neither causal nor sequential semantics.
